title: pkix-chain use-case wrappers hardwire NoAiaFetcher
description:
All eight use-case wrappers in pkix-chain (verify_tls_server through verify_ocsp_responder) hardwire NoAiaFetcher, meaning they never attempt AIA chain reassembly. The crate-level docs note: 'The use-case wrappers bake NoAiaFetcher internally; callers wanting AIA drop to verify_chain directly.'

This means any caller who wants automatic intermediate fetching via AIA AND the convenience of identity-binding / profile-enforcement wrappers must replicate the wrapper logic themselves. The Verifier struct is generic over A: AiaFetcher and supports AIA natively, but the wrappers bypass it.

What goes wrong if this stays as-is: Same issue as the DefaultVerifier hardwiring — callers who need both AIA and the wrapper's post-validation logic (identity binding, timestamping EKU checks, OCSP delegation) must replicate non-trivial wrapper code. Combined with the DefaultVerifier hardwiring, a caller needing custom crypto AND AIA AND identity binding gets no help from the wrapper layer.

Locations: All wrapper functions pass &NoAiaFetcher to verify_chain. E.g., line 800-801, 885-886, etc. in /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs
